scope: Exact Lean contract only; native Rust parsing/arithmetic/cardinality and polynomial/complete-cost bridges are not proved. Statement fidelity is a reviewer obligation.
statement: For an additive commutative group G generated by P of exact nonzero cardinality n, any finite indexed group relation sum(c_i.val times B_i)=a.val times P+b.val times Q implies sum(c_i*log(B_i))-b*log(Q)=a in ZMod n, with log constructed from the cyclic isomorphism.
